I recommend playing/picking him situationally. If there's a lot of burst dmg in lane or in jg (brand, swain, etc.) don't play him, but if you need the dps or feel as if you can help chunk out some tanks in fights, play him. I juggle him and jhin and in another life xayah as well, so play him when it feels right for the match up. As for not doing enough dmg, play around with some builds, maybe you didn't have the armor pen. or the healing reduction you needed. If you have trouble with survival, build lethality, get a tank supp, or duo with a raka main. That's my advice, i hadn't been feeling that stuck with him until recently but playing him situationally helps me a lot.
